title: What changed in AI tools — August 2026
summary: A public keep/cut digest of recorded directory changes this month: new listings, model-lineup notes, and what to re-check before you renew.

new_listings.name: HtmlSlides
new_listings.note: Vendor submission. Interactive HTML decks. Test against Gamma before adding a paid seat.

new_listings.name: Whop CLI
new_listings.note: Terminal/agent control for Whop products, plans, and checkout. Relevant if you sell on Whop.

watch_list.name: Grok
watch_list.note: Model lineup panel last checked 2026-08-26. Confirm current Grok 4.6 / Grok Build names on X before you pay for SuperGrok as a second assistant.

watch_list.name: Cursor
watch_list.note: Composer / model options move quickly. Re-run one real coding task before renewing Pro if you also pay Copilot or Claude.

watch_list.name: ChatGPT
watch_list.note: Lineup recorded as GPT-5.4 family as of 2026-08-26. Verify openai.com/pricing before annual.

watch_list.name: Claude
watch_list.note: Sonnet/Opus point releases plus Claude Code as a coding surface. Do not assume the chat plan and the coding workflow are the same job.

keep_cut_rule: If two paid tools own the same weekly job, keep one. Use a real task test, then cancel the extra seat before renewal.
